note: All sixteen brick outputs of SESSION 1, looked at at 1:1 on 2026-09-18, four crops each covering every texel. This was run as a free test of a hypothesis from session 2, that the edge conditioning role carries the faults, using data already in hand rather than a new machine. It found a second case of lettering that nobody had looked at in September, and with it the mechanism: the numerals come from the prompt. Session 1's other 48 outputs, painted render and carriageway asphalt and the sixteen footway paving, are still NOT looked at at full resolution, and nothing from them may be published.
